evidence_items.explanation: The study identifies a failure involving prior clinical information in systems that generate reports from chest images. This supports the limited inference that image-related success does not establish all the contextual capabilities required for clinical work.

The authors describe separate image-analysis and language-processing products serving different workflow functions. Their account also documents text-related capabilities, which prevents interpreting Marcus's claim as a blanket denial that AI could process clinical text.
